card.name: Inside drug class names like ARBs
card.fires_on: Partway through drug class names in interaction text, such as the word receptor in angiotensin receptor blockers or the hib in COX-2 Inhibitors. Also the closing bracket after PDE-5.

modes.label: Receptor blocker names
modes.description: The word receptor or its inner part after angiotensin (II) in ARB class names.

modes.label: Inside Inhibitors in COX-2 names
modes.description: The middle piece hib of Inhibitors when COX-2 Inhibitors is spelled out.

modes.label: Other split medical names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long organism names or the bracket closing an abbreviation like PDE-5.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of drug class names such as angiotensin receptor blockers and COX-2 inhibitors in interaction sections.
